_note: The Arduino Foundations bench: one 400-hole breadboard (A), and the Arduino Uno on the table to its left. The Uno does not go in the breadboard: wires go from its header pins to the breadboard holes. The Uno lies as in the Uno R3 drawing: the USB end on the left, the digital header (D0 to D13) far from you, and the power header near you. mount x and z: the place of the Uno corner at the USB end and the power header. open_rails: bbA.+ and bbA.- are the rails on the left, near the Uno. view: the point that the camera looks at, and the size of the bench that it shows, in hole pitches.
